# spec-standards

> Specification and documentation standard for the WyattAu estate: ten
> invariants (SPEC-CORE), prose rules (DOC-STYLE), tiered gates (S/K/A/D),
> registry schema, and templates. Sibling of engineering-standards, which
> owns code gates; the two reference each other and never fork.

- [SPEC-CORE](SPEC-CORE.md): the ten invariants, truth-table/REQ/lifecycle
  formats, oracle rule, registry schema, tiers, gate inventory
- [DOC-STYLE](DOC-STYLE.md): prose register, citation rule, character rule,
  status stamps
- [README](README.md): gate matrix, adoption snippet, rollout status
- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): repo contract and truth table
- templates/: SPEC, ADR, TRUTH-TABLE, RESEARCH_LOG skeletons; REQUIREMENTS
  and THREAT-MODEL templates remain owned by engineering-standards
- scripts/doc-lint.sh, scripts/spec-audit.py: the mechanical gates
  (POSIX shell + python3; markdownlint and PyYAML optional per script)
- docs/adr/: seed decisions 0001 (concern split), 0002 (spec location),
  0003 (DOC-STYLE move)
